source_title: Memorandum of telephone conversation: telcon with Mikhail Gorbachev, President of the Soviet Union, 25 December 1991, 10:03-10:25 a.m., Camp David
provenance_note: Downloaded directly from the NARA catalog. The dossier, the independent check and this packet returned identical bytes. This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Attributed factual paraphrases only; no source artwork or portrait copied, and no photograph, emblem, signature image or expressive source text is republished. No open license is asserted. No portrait permission or likeness approval is established.

claims.text: The White House memorandum identifies the other party to a call on 25 December 1991, 10:03-10:25 a.m., at Camp David, as 'Mikhail Gorbachev, President of the Soviet Union'; interpreter Dmitri Zarechnak, notetaker Nicholas Burns of the NSC staff.
claims.locator: PDF page 1, subject, participants and date lines
claims.uncertainty: A US record; the times are the US side's and no time zone is printed. An office observation, not a term.

claims.text: Gorbachev says he had considered making his statement on Tuesday or that day and decided to make it that day, at the end of the day; in about two hours he will speak on Moscow TV with a short statement about his decision.
claims.locator: PDF page 1, second and third Gorbachev paragraphs
claims.uncertainty: A stated intention before the broadcast, in a translated memorandum rather than a verbatim transcript.

claims.text: Gorbachev says he has on his desk a decree of the President of the USSR on his resignation; he will also resign his duties as Commander-in-Chief and transfer authority to use nuclear weapons to the President of the Russian Federation, and as soon as he announces his resignation he will put these decrees into effect. Bush later notes that the constitutional responsibilities on this issue have been passed to Boris Yeltsin.
claims.locator: PDF page 2, paragraph beginning 'Now, about Russia'; PDF page 3, first paragraph
claims.uncertainty: A report of intent, not the instruments. Whether a decree on resignation existed separately from decree UP-3162 is not established. The transfer of nuclear-use authority to the President of the Russian Federation is not an institutional succession from the USSR Presidency.

scope_note: Declassified on 23 September 2008 (stamp: E.O. 12958 as amended, 2004-1975-MR). Scanned PDF; page 4 is the library's citation sheet, not a textual record. The bush41library.tamu.edu copy redirected to a homepage and was not used.
